disclaimer: This tool helps families organize information related to release planning. It does not predict or determine whether release will occur. Families commonly work with their attorney on release strategy.

bond.info: Bond amounts and eligibility are determined by an immigration judge. General information about immigration bond procedures is available through organizations such as the American Immigration Council.

release_address.label: Intended release address
release_address.info: Families commonly prepare documentation of a stable release address. The relevance of address documentation to a specific case is a matter for the family's attorney to assess.

sponsor.info: Families commonly gather identification and financial documents for the intended bond payer. Specific requirements vary and are commonly described by the attorney handling the matter.

checklist.title: Release Readiness Checklist
checklist.subtitle: Families commonly prepare the following in advance.
items: Bond amount confirmed with attorney or court
Bond payer identified and documents gathered
